newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dollar firm, bonds fall on wages data.
newsitem.headline: Australian dollar firm, bonds fall on wages data.

text.p: The Australian dollar rose and debt futures weakened after stronger than expected data for first quarter average weekly ordinary time earnings (AWOTE).

The dollar was US$O.7822/27 compared with US$0.7815/25 just before the data release at 0130 GMT, while June 10-year bond futures contract was 92.125 against a pre-data 92.170. June bill futures also eased, falling to 94.03 from 94.10.
Quarterly AWOTE rose 1.3 percent for an annual rate of 4.6 percent compared with respective 0.8 and 4.3 percent median forecasts.
Building approvals released at the same time fell 1.8 percent against an expected 2.0 percent rise.
